Aubrey Modiba.note: Watch Modiba for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Aubrey Modiba.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Bradley Cross.summary: Bradley Cross is a South Africa left-back from Kaizer Chiefs who adds wide defending, left-footed balance, and recovery speed to the national team.
Bradley Cross.note: Cross's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Bradley Cross.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Evidence Makgopa.note: Makgopa's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Evidence Makgopa.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ime Okon.note: Watch Okon for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Ime Okon.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Iqraam Rayners.note: Rayners is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Iqraam Rayners.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Jayden Adams.note: Adams is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jayden Adams.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Kamogelo Sebelebele.note: Watch Sebelebele for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Kamogelo Sebelebele.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Khuliso Mudau.note: Mudau stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Khuliso Mudau.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Khulumani Ndamane.note: Watch Ndamane for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Khulumani Ndamane.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Lyle Foster.note: Foster's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Lyle Foster.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Mbekezeli Mbokazi.note: Mbokazi's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Mbekezeli Mbokazi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Nkosinathi Sibisi.note: Sibisi's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nkosinathi Sibisi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Olwethu Makhanya.note: Watch Makhanya for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Olwethu Makhanya.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Oswin Appollis.note: Watch Appollis for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Oswin Appollis.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Relebohile Mofokeng.note: Mofokeng is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Relebohile Mofokeng.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Ricardo Goss.note: Watch Goss for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Ricardo Goss.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ronwen Williams.note: Williams's edge is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He waits for the strike before committing. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ronwen Williams.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Samukele Kabini.note: Kabini stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Samukele Kabini.noteZh: 他的突出特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Sipho Chaine.note: Chaine stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Sipho Chaine.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Sphephelo Sithole.note: Watch Sithole for creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Sphephelo Sithole.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Teboho Mokoena.note: Mokoena stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Teboho Mokoena.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Thabang Matuludi.note: Matuludi stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Thabang Matuludi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Thalente Mbatha.note: Mbatha's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Thalente Mbatha.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Thapelo Maseko.note: Watch Maseko for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Thapelo Maseko.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Themba Zwane.note: Zwane's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Themba Zwane.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Tshepang Moremi.note: Moremi stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Tshepang Moremi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。
